'''Borofir''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Ghostling]] who was kidnapped along with [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Arawynne]] by [[Djas Puhr/Legends|Djas Puhr]], a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] who attempted to sell them into the slave trade in [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]], [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].
